########################################################################
# DEFAULT AI TRAINING POLICY
########################################################################

**default_policy: disallow**

Use of this website’s content (text, code, images, blog posts, metadata, etc.) for training, fine-tuning, benchmarking, distillation, or generative purposes by AI models is strictly prohibited without prior written consent from the owner.

########################################################################
# CRAWLER-SPECIFIC RULES
########################################################################

# === OpenAI ===
user-agent: GPTBot  
policy: disallow  
comment: Use of content for OpenAI training or inference is not permitted.

user-agent: ChatGPT-User  
policy: disallow  
comment: ChatGPT browser plugin scraping is disallowed.

# === Google AI (Gemini/Bard) ===
user-agent: Google-Extended  
policy: disallow  
comment: Google AI is restricted from accessing any data for LLM purposes.

# === Anthropic ===
user-agent: ClaudeBot  
policy: disallow  
comment: Claude and associated services may not use this content.

# === Perplexity AI ===
user-agent: PerplexityBot  
policy: disallow  
comment: Perplexity is not permitted to index or use site content.

# === Meta AI ===
user-agent: FacebookBot  
policy: disallow  
comment: No content allowed for Meta's generative models.

# === Amazon AI ===
user-agent: Amazonbot  
policy: disallow

# === Common Crawl / Open LLMs ===
user-agent: CCBot  
policy: disallow  
comment: Common Crawl is restricted from indexing due to downstream LLM usage.

# === Other Bots ===
user-agent: YouBot  
policy: disallow

user-agent: NeevaAI  
policy: disallow

user-agent: CohereBot  
policy: disallow

user-agent: AI21LabsBot  
policy: disallow

user-agent: *  
policy: disallow  
comment: Blanket restriction for all unidentified or experimental AI crawlers.
